summary.text: Arlie Hetrick Jr., also known as Chip, is the Democratic candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 77 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His campaign website describes him as a retired union industrial painter who lives on a small farm in western Maine.

paragraphs.text: Hetrick writes on his campaign website that he grew up in a union family in West Virginia, where his parents worked in a glass plant.
He spent 22 years as a union industrial painter, working on bridges, power plants and refineries, and after retiring he and his wife settled in Maine and built their life on a small farm.
Hetrick advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
His site lists good jobs, protecting Social Security and Medicare, and affordability as his focus, and names Canton, Dixfield, Hartford, Livermore, Mexico and Peru as the communities in District 77.
